title: 第768章 开春卜卦大凶第767章 建厂
slug: 乱世荒年我每日一卦粮肉满仓
content_zh:
方闻舟去了郡城又回到三山镇后。
没多久江尘收到了通过胡四海从三山镇运过来的一百五十架军中劲弩。
这批劲弩先从和朔县运到三山镇，之后胡四海以拿去跟赵国交易为理由进了山，然后又经上林泊悄无声息地重新运回了和朔县。
这批劲弩在入夜时分进了城，被摆到江尘在城北那座专门研发武器的格物坊内。
江尘天一亮就特意赶了过去，等看到那些劲弩的时候，着实吓了一跳。
那些弩身比他想象的还要大。
整具弩长四尺有余，通体刷上深褐防腐大漆，看起来凶光四射，杀气腾腾。
江尘上前摸了摸，手碰到了弩臂最前端的一对铁制蹬环上。
“怎么用的？”江尘回头问去。
胡四海赶忙上前，带来一个弓着背的老头。
其接过劲弩，双脚踩住环扣，腰身发力，那弩弓才缓缓张开，发出吱呀声响，可半晌竟是没有撑开。
江尘顺势夺过，一脚蹬环，吱呀一声，终于将弩彻底拉满，挂到弦上。
江尘将弩提起，手握在那弩箭下面的青铜弩机上，朝着旁边的墙壁一扣。
砰的一声，塞在弹道里面的弩箭疾射而出，钉入六十步步外的土墙中，箭镞深深没入墙体。
江尘看得不由面色一喜，随即又觉得手臂微微发麻。
“可惜。”威力比江尘想象的大，可也跟江尘想象的有太多区别。
这种制式的劲弩，寻常将士绝对无法双臂开弩，必须下到地面，用脚蹬着才能张开、再次上弦。
他本来想让兵士带着骑射，现在想来最多只能上好弦之后，在马上射出一轮，之后便需翻身下马，再次上弦才能使用。
不过再次确认了这弩箭的威力，他也没觉得自己吃亏。
这才是真正的劲弩，恐怕五十步内能射穿铁甲。

若是皮甲，更是能径直贯入两层，百步之内也能造成威慑。
江尘迅速将这些劲弩收入库中，随后便交给格物坊内的匠人以及学生，开始拆解结构，准备仿制，顺便再尽量做一些轻便的、能单兵使用的轻弩。
如今想想，赵氏他们应该是真的很缺战马了，否则也不至于拿这等劲弩出来交换。
一百匹正当年战马，换这一百五十架弩机，江尘也觉得不亏了。
.........................
北疆的冬天向来来得比较早，江尘的建厂计划刚开始便因为入冬不得不停止。
不过江尘也不急，反正不论是扩大酒厂，还是外售肥皂，都不是一朝一夕能做到的，慢慢来就是了。
今年又是一个暖冬，雨雪比去年又少了一些。
这让众人心头又有几分担忧，生怕明年又有旱情。
但又有几分庆幸，还好自己入冬之前又修了水利、建了沟渠，就算来年雨水少一些，应该也不会有什么问题。
有如此想法，众人也就安安静静地过了年。
年关一过，未到三月便开始化冻，这也是江尘记忆中化冻最早的一年。
三月未到，江尘看了看头顶积蓄的光华，找了一个无人的地方，开始卜卦。
【命星：镇将】
【小吉：有一支叛军正从洪泉峪向北而来，提前设伏，或可截杀叛军，立下功劳。】
【平：无事发生，春日即将来临，陈氏练兵，以待后时。】
【平：附近有小股流匪游荡，带兵前去清剿，可免于袭扰，影响春耕。】
“叛军北逃？”
江尘看了一下卦签，心中一动，怎么又往北逃了？还从峪口窜过来？
他提前得知消息，要是在峪口上下设伏，的确能够将其截杀，将其全军覆没也没什么难度。

可最终江尘还是放弃了这个想法。
这些是朝廷的麻烦，暂时还不是和朔县的麻烦，他要功劳也没什么用。
他更关心的是那些叛军为什么要往北逃？难道是南边已经混不下去了？或是说朝廷剿匪有了什么成效？
content_en:
Fang Wenzhou went to the county town and returned to Sanshan Town.
Not long after, Jiang Chen received one hundred and fifty military crossbows shipped from Sanshan Town through Hu Sihai.
These powerful crossbows were first transported from Heshuo County to Sanshan Town, and then Hu Sihai entered the mountains on the pretext of using them to trade with Zhao State, and then quietly transported them back to Heshuo County via Linbo.
This batch of powerful crossbows entered the city at nightfall and were placed in Jiang Chen's Gwufang in the north of the city, which specializes in research and development of weapons.
Jiang Chen rushed there as soon as it was dawn. When he saw those powerful crossbows, he was really shocked.
Those crossbows were bigger than he imagined.
The entire crossbow is more than four feet long and is painted with dark brown anti-corrosion paint. It looks fierce and murderous.
Jiang Chen stepped forward and touched it, and his hands touched the pair of iron pedal rings at the front end of the crossbow arm.
"How to use it?" Jiang Chen turned around and asked.
Hu Sihai hurried forward and brought an old man with a hunched back.
He took the crossbow, stepped on the buckle with both feet, and exerted force on his waist. The crossbow slowly opened and made a squeaking sound, but it did not open for a long time.
Jiang Chen took advantage of the situation and grabbed it, kicked the ring, and with a squeak, he finally fully pulled the crossbow and hung it on the string.
Jiang Chen lifted up the crossbow, held the bronze crossbow machine under the crossbow arrows, and clicked it towards the wall next to it.
With a bang, the crossbow arrow stuffed in the ballistic path shot out quickly, nailing into the earthen wall sixty steps away, and the arrowhead sank deeply into the wall.
Jiang Chen couldn't help but look happy when he saw it, and then he felt his arms were slightly numb.
"It's a pity." The power was greater than Jiang Chen imagined, but it was also very different from what Jiang Chen imagined.
With this type of crossbow, ordinary soldiers would never be able to fire it with both arms. They had to go down to the ground and push it with their feet to open it and cock it again.
He originally wanted the soldiers to shoot on horseback, but now that he thought about it, the most they could do was to string the weapon and shoot one round on the horse. After that, he had to dismount and string the gun again before it could be used.
However, after once again confirming the power of this crossbow, he did not feel that he was at a disadvantage.
This is a truly powerful crossbow. I am afraid it can penetrate iron armor within fifty steps.
If it is leather armor, it can penetrate directly into two layers and can cause deterrence within a hundred steps.
Jiang Chen quickly put these powerful crossbows into the warehouse, and then handed them over to the craftsmen and students in Gewufang, who began to dismantle the structures and prepare to imitate them. At the same time, he tried to make some light crossbows that were lightweight and could be used by individual soldiers.
Thinking about it now, Zhao and the others must be really short of war horses, otherwise they wouldn't have traded for such powerful crossbows.
Jiang Chen felt that it was not a loss in exchange for one hundred and fifty war horses for these one hundred and fifty crossbows.
.............................
Winter always comes relatively early in Northern Xinjiang, and Jiang Chen's plan to build a factory had to be stopped right after it started.
However, Jiang Chen is not in a hurry. Anyway, whether it is expanding the winery or selling soap, it cannot be done overnight, so just take your time.
This year is another warm winter, with less rain and snow than last year.
This makes everyone a little worried, fearing that there will be another drought next year.
But I'm a little lucky. Fortunately, I repaired water conservancy and built ditches before winter. Even if there is less rain next year, there shouldn't be any problems.
With such thoughts, everyone spent the New Year quietly.
As soon as the New Year passed, the thaw began before March. This was also the earliest thaw in Jiang Chen's memory.
Before March arrived, Jiang Chen looked at the accumulated brilliance above his head, found a deserted place, and began to divine.
[Destiny Star: General]
[Xiaoji: There is a rebel army coming north from Hongquan Valley. If you set up an ambush in advance, you may be able to intercept and kill the rebels and make a contribution. 】
[Ping: Nothing happened, spring is coming, Chen is training his troops for the future. 】
[Ping: There is a small group of bandits wandering nearby. Leading troops to eliminate them can avoid harassment and affect spring plowing. 】
"Rebels fleeing north?"
Jiang Chen looked at the hexagram sign and felt something in his heart.Dong Dong, why did you flee north again? Are you still coming from the valley?
He learned the news in advance that if he set up an ambush up and down the valley, he could indeed be intercepted and killed, and it would not be difficult to annihilate his entire army.
But in the end Jiang Chen gave up this idea.
These are the troubles of the imperial court, not Heshuo County for the time being, and it is useless for him to take credit.
What he was more concerned about was why those rebels fled north? Could it be that the south can no longer survive? Or what was the effectiveness of the imperial court's suppression of bandits?
